biotools.summary: METALizer predicts the coordination geometry of metal ions in metalloproteins. Users can compare potential coordination geometries to those found in the examined structure. The predicted coordination geometries and the observed metal interaction distances can be interactively compared to statistics calculated based on the PDB.
